blocks.text: Greenwood is a British surname, believed to be derived from the Greenwood or Greenwode settlement near Heptonstall in the metropolitan district of Calderdale in West Yorkshire. It was the homestead of Wyomarus de Greenwode, believed to be the principal ancestor of British Greenwoods, though some claim to be of French descent.
Greenwood is a rural locality in the Toowoomba Region, Queensland, Australia. In the 2021 census, Greenwood had a population of 34 people.
